caption: The drawing depicts a single glass decanter with a stopper, rendered in grayscale on a beige background. The decanter has a round, bulbous body with vertical grooves along its sides, and a prominent circular medallion on the front displaying a starburst or radial geometric pattern. The neck of the decanter is tall and narrows upwards, leading to a wide, flat rim. The stopper is spherical and has a matching starburst pattern etched or cut into its surface, mirroring the design on the body. The entire object is encased within a rectangular border near the edges of the drawing. The artist's signature, "FUMAGALLI," appears in the lower left corner within the border.
title: Bottle
